supersedes: New3D geometry/groom resource budget; original2D art budget file and its evidence remain unchanged, not a retrospective performance waiver

artTextures.accounting: Conservative decoded width*height*4 including mip chains and temporary overlap; compression savings reported separately, never double count shared textures. Framebuffers/native process memory separately included in original384MiB RSS gate.

mobileLow.fur: Reduced authored groom cards/normal detail; keep3D silhouette and saved parts

mobileBalanced.postprocessing: No mandatory SSAO,SSR,bloom or full-resolution DOF
mobileBalanced.fur: Authored groom cards with bounded overdraw; no strand simulation

desktopHigh.postprocessing: Optional after measurement; gameplay no depth-of-field blur
desktopHigh.fur: Extra closeup/near cards within frame/texture caps

jsGrowthAfter20Visits.rule: Original max(absolute,relative) over consistent warm baseline

measurementProtocol: Pin source/renderer/model/material/catalog/toolchain/quality tier and device/OS/WebView/GPU; record unsupported shader/extensions separately
Measure cold/warm load,decoded resources,drawcalls/triangles,framep95/stalls,memory growth/disposal and context recovery on exact build
Report physical Android thermal/battery/30minute workload under unchanged android-spike.json; browser/AVD values separate
Retain failed results and any quality reduction; no after-failure threshold increase or resetting old profile
changePolicy: Preserve revision1 and all measured failures; any future limit change needs a new revision/reason locked before separate measurement, never edits this file to PASS
